god.olympus.apollo.epithet: God of the Sun, Music and Healing
god.olympus.artemis.epithet: Goddess of the Hunt and the Moon
god.olympus.hades.epithet: Lord of the Underworld, the Unseen One
god.olympus.hephaestus.epithet: God of the Forge and Fire
god.olympus.hermes.epithet: Messenger of the Gods, Patron of Travelers
god.olympus.zeus.epithet: King of the Gods, Lord of the Sky and Thunder
item.olympus.aegis.blessed: Every %sth blocked hit releases a shockwave that knocks back and smites hostile mobs within %s blocks.
item.olympus.aegis.blessed.name: Divine Shockwave
item.olympus.aegis.primary: Blocking a melee hit has a %s chance to strike the attacker with lightning.
item.olympus.blade_of_ares.blessed: Mobs within %s blocks are weakened; you and nearby players gain Speed II for %ss.
item.olympus.blade_of_ares.blessed.name: War Cry
item.olympus.blade_of_ares.primary: Each kill grants Strength I for %ss. Another kill during the fury raises it to Strength II.
item.olympus.conch_of_the_deep.blessed: Launch forward like Riptide, even on dry land.
item.olympus.conch_of_the_deep.primary: Right-click: Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace for %ss.
item.olympus.divine_smithing_template.ad: Add a Block of Olympian Bronze
item.olympus.divine_smithing_template.ba: Add netherite gear or a trident
item.olympus.goblet_of_dionysus.blessed: Players within %s blocks get a random blessing for %ss; mobs stagger drunkenly.
item.olympus.goblet_of_dionysus.primary: Drink: a random blessing for %ss, with a %s chance of a hangover instead. Never empties.
item.olympus.hammer_of_hephaestus.blesse: Instantly smelts up to %s items from the stack in your offhand.
item.olympus.hammer_of_hephaestus.primar: Ores you mine come out already smelted (Silk Touch keeps the ore).
item.olympus.helm_of_darkness.blessed: While invisible, your first hit deals %sx damage and ends the invisibility.
item.olympus.helm_of_darkness.primary: Sneak in place for %ss to become fully invisible, armor and all, for %ss.
item.olympus.lyre_of_apollo.blessed: Sets hostile mobs within %s blocks ablaze and blinds enemies for %ss.
item.olympus.lyre_of_apollo.blessed.name: Sunburst
item.olympus.lyre_of_apollo.primary: Right-click: Regeneration II for you and every player within %s blocks for %ss.
item.olympus.mirror_of_aphrodite.blessed: The mob you look at fights for you for %ss. Bosses and players resist.
item.olympus.mirror_of_aphrodite.primary: Right-click: hostile mobs within %s blocks stop targeting you for %ss, and nearby animals fall in love.
item.olympus.owl_of_athena.blessed: You and players within %s blocks gain Strength I and Resistance I for %ss.
item.olympus.owl_of_athena.blessed.name: Battle Wisdom
item.olympus.owl_of_athena.primary: Right-click: every creature and player within %s blocks glows for %ss.
item.olympus.sickle_of_demeter.blessed: Harvests and replants every ripe crop in a %sx%s area.
item.olympus.sickle_of_demeter.primary: Right-click crops: everything in a %sx%s area ripens instantly.
item.olympus.silver_bow.blessed: Your next shot fires %s arrows in a spread for the cost of one (within %ss).
item.olympus.silver_bow.blessed.name: Volley
item.olympus.silver_bow.primary: Arrows fly perfectly straight, and anything they hit glows for %ss.
item.olympus.talaria.blessed: Triple jump, and you never take fall damage.
item.olympus.talaria.blessed.name: Wings of Hermes
item.olympus.talaria.primary: Permanent Speed I and a double jump while worn.

olympus.claim.title: You have been claimed by %s!
olympus.command.not_god_item: Hold a god item in your main hand.
olympus.message.goblet_hangover: Hic! Perhaps one cup too many…
